## TestDoubleMisuseError class

Thrown when a test-only double — a class built purely to fabricate a vaultkeeper-internal signal (e.g. a granted presence check, an unlocked backend) for driving negative test cases — refuses to construct because it detected it is running outside a test environment.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class TestDoubleMisuseError extends VaultError 
```
**Extends:** [VaultError](./vaultkeeper.vaulterror.md)

## Remarks

A fabricated signal is, by construction, exactly the thing a real deployment must never be able to forge. A loud, typed refusal at construction time is the last of several stacked guards keeping such a double unreachable from production — see, for example, `PresenceSimulatorBackend` in `@vaultkeeper/test-helpers`<!-- -->. Inspect [TestDoubleMisuseError.doubleName](./vaultkeeper.testdoublemisuseerror.doublename.md) for which class refused to construct and [TestDoubleMisuseError.detectedEnvironment](./vaultkeeper.testdoublemisuseerror.detectedenvironment.md) for the environment value that triggered the refusal.
